title: 第一卷 第5章 新生与美妇宫主的羁绊第一卷 第6章 穆婉心意赠灵乳
content_zh:
秦逸这一剑，已然是他当前所能达到的极限爆发。
李刚遭受了魂断三生秘术冲击灵魂，哪怕只是刹那，他就已经反应了过来，但依旧晚了！
秦逸的剑锋，已然斩下。
李刚的身体，直接从头到脚，化作两半，猛然炸开。
魔吞天地！
秦逸施展术法，魔气卷动，淹没了李刚的两半尸体。
顿时，李刚尸体中的气血，还有未曾散去的残魂，都被魔像吞噬。
秦逸双眼血红，身上散发出无比暴戾凶残之意，这一刻，他恨不得继续挥剑，将周围的一切都给毁灭！
“醒来！”
这时，一道洪亮的声音，在秦逸的脑海中炸响。
小鼎震荡，散发出灵光。
秦逸全身一颤，他眼中的血光散去，恢复了明亮。
“记住，你修魔功，你利用的是魔功的力量，你不是魔功的奴隶！”
“这一批已经杀完了！”
“马上就会有其他人赶到，立刻走！”
“嗯！”秦逸不敢耽搁，立刻化作一抹遁光而去。
很快，他便按照鼎爷的提示，甩掉了追兵。
行走在人潮涌动的天星城街道上。
感受着温暖的阳光，呼吸着清新的空气，听着周围各种各样的声音。
这一刻，秦逸的眼眶，浮现了些许的泪光。

九年了！
九年暗无天日，被关押在地牢中，被秦沧那群卑鄙无耻之徒迫害。
如今，终于重见天日！
“小子，趁着秦沧现在还没有收到消息，你还有时间离开天星城。”鼎爷的声音响起。
然而。
秦逸却摇了摇头，传音鼎爷：“鼎爷，我不打算走。”
“秦沧在天星城，但天星城不是秦家的，而是天星武院的，所以，秦家在天星城还无法做到只手遮天。”
“我若此刻逃出天星城，以后便要过上隐姓埋名，甚至是不断被追杀的生活。”
“我不想那样！”
“秦飞雪即将要参加天星武院的考核！”
“而且，秦沧第七子，获得了我五行道脉的秦安，也在天星武院！”
“所以，我要参加天星武院的考核，在考核期间，将属于我的先天剑魂拿回来！”
“等我加入了天星武院，我便能寻找机会，将五行道脉也收回来！”
“除此之外，我爹曾经是天星武院的弟子，天星武院一位宫主，是我爹的师妹，我爹失踪前，来天星武院找过那位宫主。”
“或许，那位宫主，知道我爹到底去了哪里！”
秦逸已经做出了决定。
鼎爷：“不错，你的思路很清晰，那就按照你自己的计划去做！”
秦逸：“鼎爷，多谢您。”
content_en:
Qin Yi's sword was already the ultimate explosion he could achieve at present.
Li Gang suffered the impact of the soul-breaking three-life secret technique on his soul. Even if it was only for a moment, he had already reacted, but it was still too late!
Qin Yi's sword edge has already been cut down.
Li Gang's body split into two halves from head to toe and suddenly exploded.
Demon swallows the world!
Qin Yi cast a spell, and the demonic energy swirled, submerging the two halves of Li Gang's body.
Immediately, the blood and blood in Li Gang's corpse, as well as the remaining soul that had not dispersed, were swallowed by the demon statue.
Qin Yi's eyes were blood red, and he exuded an extremely violent and ferocious look. At this moment, he wanted to continue swinging his sword and destroy everything around him!
"Wake up!"
At this time, a loud voice exploded in Qin Yi's mind.
The small cauldron vibrated and emitted spiritual light.
Qin Yi's whole body trembled, and the blood in his eyes dissipated and brightness returned.
"Remember, when you practice magic skills, you are using the power of magic skills. You are not a slave of magic skills!"
"This batch has been killed!"
"Others will arrive soon, leave now!"
"Yeah!" Qin Yi didn't dare to delay, and immediately turned into a flash of light and left.
Soon, he followed Master Ding's instructions and got rid of his pursuers.
Walking on the crowded streets of Tianxing City.
Feel the warm sunshine, breathe the fresh air, and listen to the various sounds around you.
At this moment, some tears appeared in Qin Yi's eyes.
Nine years!
He was kept in darkness for nine years, imprisoned in a dungeon, and persecuted by Qin Cang's group of despicable and shameless people.
Now, finally see the light of day again!
"Boy, while Qin Cang hasn't received the news yet, you still have time to leave Tianxing City." Master Ding's voice sounded.
However.
Qin Yi shook his head and called Master Ding: "Master Ding, I don't plan to leave."
"Qin Cang is in Tianxing City, but Tianxing City does not belong to the Qin family, but to the Tianxing Martial Academy. Therefore, the Qin family cannot cover the sky with one hand in Tianxing City."
"If I escape Tianxing City now, I will live a life of anonymity or even be constantly hunted."
"I don't want that!"
"Qin Feixue is about to take the assessment of Tianxing Martial Academy!"
"Moreover, Qin Cang's seventh son, Qin An, who has obtained my Five Elements Dao Lineage, is also in the Tianxing Martial Academy!"
"So, I want to take part in the assessment of Tianxing Martial Arts Academy, and during the assessment period, I will get back my innate sword soul!"
"When I join the Tianxing Martial Academy, I can look for opportunities to take back the Five Elements Dao Meridian!"
"In addition, my father was once a disciple of the Tianxing Martial Academy. There was a palace master in the Tianxing Martial Academy who was my father's junior sister. Before my father disappeared, he came to the Tianxing Martial Academy to look for the palace lord."
"Perhaps, that palace master knows where my father has gone!"
Qin Yi has already made a decision.
Master Ding: "Yes, your thinking is very clear, then just follow your own plan!"
Qin Yi: "Master Ding, thank you very much."
